_license: Two sources. Kaboompics Standard License (kaboompics.com/page/terms-of-use, read 2026-10-26): commercial use; model releases on file; never imply personal endorsement, participation or recommendation. Pexels License (pexels.com/license, read 2026-10-27): commercial use, no attribution needed; no model releases are collected, and identifiable people must not be shown in a way that implies they endorse a product or in a bad light. So for both: no names, quotes, handles, results or product UI on these people. They illustrate a side of the market, unnamed. Pexels photos are credited in the `credit` field even though the license doesn't ask for it.
_how: Originals live in design/people/originals/<id>.jpg (Pexels: images.pexels.com/photos/<n>/pexels-photo-<n>.jpeg). Run `python3 scripts/people.py` to build public/assets/people/ (480 to 3200 wide). `grade: warm` bakes the site's photo grade (design/texture/README.md). Kaboompics entries without an original build from design/people/standins/; none are used on the site now.

_spots: Where a photo's people are looking, so the phone or the sign-up card can sit there (Scene.astro). Fractions of the whole photo: z is the photo's width as a multiple of the screen's, x the object's centre, tx where on screen that centre lands, y0 to y1 the rows shown, top the object's top, h the phone's height (phone) or w the card's width (form), all in photo widths or heights. `m` is the same for phones (960px and under).
